items.q: What is the complexity of merge sort?
items.why: The answer examiners want is: O(n log n). “O(n)” is the distractor this question was built around — if it tempted you, that's the exact gap to close.

items.q: Which describes accessing an array element by index?
items.why: Correct answer: O(1). “O(log n)” sounds right because it borrows the language of the topic — but it fails this question. Re-read the notes on why.
The real figure is 10 value. The wrong options cluster deliberately close — anchor the exact number to one concrete fact so it can't drift.
